about.label: Who I Am
about.heading: Bridging backend complexity with frontend elegance.
paragraphs: As a Full Stack Engineer, I build complete, end-to-end solutions. I excel at architecting secure, multi-tenant SaaS platforms in Laravel while also building dynamic, real-time UIs in React. My passion lies in solving complex data problems and building systems that are both reliable and efficient.

My approach is defined by full-cycle ownership, from architecting a secure RBAC system to engineering an asynchronous bulk import. I make it my goal to bridge the gap between deep backend complexity and a clean, intuitive user experience.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.subheading: My professional journey in software engineering.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
bullets: Engineered an Enterprise-Grade CMDB & ETL Pipeline: Designed a versatile ETL pipeline and custom Data Connectors to continuously synchronize master configurations and ingest network inventories directly from Stablenet into a centralized Configuration Management Database, decreasing data processing time by 60%.

Implemented Multi-Layered Security & Multi-Tenancy: Engineered a schema-per-tenant data engine and robust security framework (2FA, token authentication, RBAC), achieving 100% data isolation and reducing system vulnerabilities by 40%.

Architected a Custom EAV Engine & Dynamic UI Builder: Engineered a highly flexible data modeling system in Laravel allowing users to extend application schemas on the fly; dynamically rendered customized UI forms with real-time validation based on attribute types, enhancing the user's UI experience by 30%.

Owned the development of Asynchronous Bulk Data Sync Engine: Handled the end-to-end development of a heavy-duty import/export feature with granular conflict resolution; utilized Laravel queues for background processing and WebSockets for real-time tracking, reducing manual data entry time by over 80% and eliminating import errors.

Created a State-Aware Real-Time Monitoring Dashboard: Developed a full-stack Monitoring Dashboard that continuously fetches and maps Stablenet device alarms against configurable temporal thresholds; this dynamic observability decreased the Mean Time to Acknowledgment (MTTA) for critical alerts by 50%.

Developed a JSON-Driven Low-Code Engine: Built an advanced Pages and Layouts module utilizing recursive PHP functions to parse deeply nested JSON layout arrays; successfully decoupled frontend rendering from backend logic, allowing users to hot-swap complex UI structures via a one-to-many relational architecture.

jobs.title: Frontend Intern
bullets: Spearheaded the design & implementation of a Survey & Quizz web app as a single page application in ReactJs, with Single Sign On & Social authentications including Google Auth, Facebook & LinkedIn.
Developed heatmaps for users data, activities, user submitted surveys & responses for statistical purposes & improvising survey recommendations flow.

projects.title: ScrollNavigator
projects.description: LLM Scroll Navigator is a vanilla JavaScript browser extension (Manifest V3) that adds keyboard shortcuts, a draggable UI widget, and a minimap for quickly navigating through long conversations on popular LLM web interfaces. It currently supports ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

projects.title: mongo-aggregate
projects.description: A fluent, chainable API designed to abstract complex MongoDB aggregation stages ($match, $lookup) into intuitive methods like where() and select().

projects.title: FraudShield
projects.description: Fraud Shield is a transaction-scoring pipeline designed to evaluate incoming payment events against a sliding window of recent activity in real-time. It returns an approve/decline/review decision in under 50ms while guaranteeing no data is lost during asynchronous processing.

projects.title: ZeroScale
projects.description: ZeroScale monitors HTTP traffic and automatically scales your Kubernetes Deployments down to zero replicas when idle, saving cluster resources. When a new request comes in, the ZeroScale proxy intercepts the request, buffers it, triggers a scale-up of the target deployment, and seamlessly forwards the traffic once the pod is ready.
